issues.jp_before: {万一[まんいち]/もし|av-moshi}ここで事故[じこ]が起[お]きたら、大[おお]きな問題[もんだい]になる。
issues.problem: Distractor きっと can be read as a sentence adverb on the main clause ('surely, if an accident happens here, it will be a big problem'), so it is not plainly wrong.
issues.action: Replaced distractor きっと with ぜひ.

issues.jp_before: {仮[かり]に/もし|av-moshi}この話[はなし]が本当[ほんとう]だとしたら、大[おお]きな問題[もんだい]になる。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of the 万一 accident item (same main clause 大きな問題になる).
issues.action: Rewrote main clause to すぐに調べる必要がある and updated the English.

issues.jp_before: {仮[かり]に/もし|av-moshi}給料[きゅうりょう]が二倍[にばい]になれば、生活[せいかつ]はずっと楽[らく]になるだろう。
issues.problem: Distractor きっと is acceptable here: きっと…だろう co-occurs naturally as a sentence adverb on the main clause.
issues.action: Replaced distractor きっと with ぜひ.

issues.jp_before: {仮[かり]に/もし|av-moshi}計画[けいかく]が失敗[しっぱい]したら、責任[せきにん]は誰[だれ]が取[と]るのですか。
issues.problem: 万一 (an unwelcome possibility) is equally natural with the same English but was not listed.
issues.action: Added 万一 as an alternative.

issues.jp_before: もし車[くるま]を{買[か]うなら/買[か]ったら|av-moshi}、小[ちい]さいのがいいです。
issues.problem: 買ったら is not natural here: the preference about which car to choose comes before buying, so only なら fits.
issues.action: Removed the alternative 買ったら.

issues.jp_before: {たとえ|av-tatoe}冗談[じょうだん]でも、そんなことを言[い]ってはいけません。
issues.problem: いくら冗談でも is just as natural with the same meaning but was not listed.
issues.action: Added いくら as an alternative.

issues.jp_before: たとえ天気[てんき]が{悪[わる]くても|av-tatoe}、遠足[えんそく]は予定[よてい]どおり行[い]きます。
issues.problem: 遠足は…行きます is unnatural; holding a school trip as planned is 遠足は予定どおり行います.
issues.action: Changed 行[い]きます to 行[おこな]います.
